lines.r1: Scrum has three accountabilities, each solving a different problem.
lines.r2: The Product Owner decides what is most valuable to build, and why.
lines.r3: The Developers decide how to build it, and own the quality.
lines.r4: The Scrum Master removes obstacles and helps the team improve.
lines.v1: Each event exists to inspect and adapt.
lines.v2: Sprint Planning agrees what we can deliver, and how.
lines.v3: The Daily Scrum is a short check on progress toward the goal.
lines.v4: The Sprint Review shows the increment and gathers feedback.
lines.v5: The Retrospective improves how the team works.
